name: Eli Venturini
summary: Eli Venturini - ready-to-play pre-generated investigator (history lecturer, Folly consultant).
notes: Imported from the Rivers of London rulebook, Appendix A: Ready-to-Play Investigators (printed p.343-349). Stat block reproduced for in-game use; backstory paraphrased. Unallocated pre-gen (scope []): a GM can assign it to a player to pick up and play.

sheet.name: Eli Venturini
sheet.backstory: A history lecturer specialising in the 17th century and the life of Isaac Newton; adopted, Kent grammar-school background, recruited by the Folly after a TV quiz-show appearance revealed a shared interest.
sheet.carry: Folly Consultant's Card, University photo ID, leather-bound journal, fountain pens, mobile phone and spare batteries.
